# T-79 — what goes INSIDE the Android APK (owner, 22/09/2026: the criterion is
# mechanical, never a judgement call). A PR touching one of these gets a dev
# APK through Firebase App Distribution; anything else — docs, tests, CI,
# web-only, server-only — builds none. A server change already reaches the dev
# project through the PR's own `db-gate`.
#
# A line ending in `/` is a PREFIX; any other line is ONE exact file.
app/lib/
app/android/
app/assets/
app/pubspec.yaml
app/pubspec.lock
packages/entrelares_core/lib/
packages/entrelares_core/pubspec.yaml
packages/entrelares_db_contracts/lib/
packages/entrelares_db_contracts/pubspec.yaml
.fvmrc
